mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_presence(session_id,foreground_seen_at) SELECT s.id,#{now} FROM user_session s JOIN user_account u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND s.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.credential_version=s.credential_version AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > #{now} ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET foreground_seen_at=greatest(session_presence.foreground_seen_at,excluded.foreground_seen_at)
